Part_Guideline: Questions 1-6. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Passage:
LIBRARY NOTICE
Please keep quiet in the reading area.
No food or drinks allowed.
Question: What does this notice say?
Opt_A: You can eat your lunch here.
Opt_B: You must not make a noise here.
Explanation: 'Keep quiet' đồng nghĩa với 'must not make a noise' (không được làm ồn).

Part_Guideline: Questions 7-13. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Passage:
A - Anna
I love playing tennis. I play every weekend with my friends at the local park. It keeps me fit and healthy.

B - Bella
Reading is my favorite hobby. I usually read fantasy books in my bedroom. I don't really like sports.

C - Chloe
I enjoy painting. I go to an art class on Wednesdays. Sometimes I paint pictures of my cat.
Question: Who plays a sport outside?
Explanation: Anna chơi tennis ở công viên (outside/sport).

Part_Guideline: Questions 14-18. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Passage:
A Teenage Chef

Tom is a 14-year-old boy who loves cooking. He started cooking when he was just eight years old. His grandmother taught him how to make cakes. At first, he only baked sweet things, but now he can cook big meals for his whole family.

Last year, Tom entered a cooking competition on TV. He didn't win first prize, but the judges loved his food. Because of the TV show, many people know him now. Next month, Tom is going to open his own small cafe near his school. He is very excited.
Question: Who taught Tom how to cook?
Explanation: Đoạn văn ghi rõ: 'His grandmother taught him how to make cakes'.

Part_Guideline: Questions 19-24. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Passage:
Elephants

Elephants are the largest land animals in the world. They live in Africa and Asia. Elephants are very clever and they have very good (19) ........ They can remember things for a long time. They eat a lot of food every day, mostly leaves and grass.
Question: Choose the correct word for gap (19)
Explanation: Câu tiếp theo là 'They can remember things for a long time' nên từ cần điền là 'memories' (trí nhớ).

Part_Guideline: Questions 25-30. For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
Passage:
To: David
From: John

Hi David,
How are you? I am having a great holiday in Spain. The weather is very hot and sunny. Yesterday, we went to the beach and swam (25) ........ the sea. Tomorrow, we are going to visit a museum. 

See you soon,
John
Question: Write ONE word for gap (25)
Explanation: Giới từ đi với 'the sea' để chỉ việc bơi lội dưới biển là 'in' (swam in the sea).

Part_Guideline: Question 31. Read the email from your English friend, Alex. Write an email to Alex and answer the questions.
Passage:
I want to buy a present for my brother's birthday. 
- What should I buy for him?
- Where can I buy it?
- How much does it cost?

Write 25 words or more.
Answer:
Hi Alex,
You should buy a football for your brother because he loves sports. You can buy it at the sports shop in the shopping mall. It costs about 15 pounds.
See you,
[Your Name]
Explanation: Thí sinh cần viết một email dài hơn 25 từ, trả lời đủ 3 ý: Mua gì, Mua ở đâu, Giá bao nhiêu.

Part_Guideline: Question 32. Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures. Write 35 words or more.
Passage: Write a story based on the pictures provided.
Answer: Yesterday, a boy was riding his bicycle in the park. Suddenly, a small dog ran in front of him. The boy fell off his bike and hurt his leg, but the dog was okay.
Explanation: Học sinh cần viết một câu chuyện có logic dựa trên 3 bức tranh (đạp xe -> chó chạy ra -> ngã xe). Độ dài tối thiểu 35 từ.
